name: Teletechnopath
body:
Prerequisite(s): Technologist, Technopath, and telepathy or the ability to use detect thoughts or mindlink as a spell or spell-like ability

Benefit(s): You can mentally interface computers and devices with your Technopath feat within close range (25 feet + 5 feet/2 levels). You do not need to touch an item to manipulate it.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. If taken a second time, the range of is increased to medium (100 feet + 10 feet/level). If taken a third time, the range is increased to long (400 feet + 40 feet/level).
